title: Read the bandit download fallback
description: You inspect the optional archive and download branches.

steps.description: You import archive and path tools before trying the Colab files import. The protected block also covers later archive and download calls.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. Otherwise, the helper prints No artifacts folder found.

steps.question: What happens if the download call raises an exception?
steps.answer: The except block prints its helper-unavailable message followed by the exception text.

steps.description: You see that message in the recording. It states that google.colab.files.download is unavailable in code-viz.
